messages.subject: How to interpret the lavaan dataset
parts:
Dear Lavaan users.
I would like to request you any help about how to interpret the output from lavaan test.
Initially, I run some lavaan syntax in intention to fit CFA model with data observed. After I got results but I don' t know how to interpret them. I think there are some keywords like p<value, etc,... to look at. So can u guide me to see which criteria I can follow to interpret those data?
Looking forward to get help from u?
Regards.

messages.author: e4a3215063481170
messages.subject: Re: How to interpret the lavaan dataset
parts:
Hi,
 
The lavaan output are quite similar with most of the output of SEM software. It consists of model fit index, parameter estimates and information about var-cov matrix. You can easily find a lot examples by google, they may not be outputs from lavaan, but from for example, Mplus, lisrel, EQS, etc.
 
Hope this help.
 
ya
